meta.name: Route Telegram customer complaints with OpenAI and Google Sheets

name: AI Customer Complaint Resolution & Smart Escalation System

parameters.content:
## 📦 ResolveOS AI – Wrong-Package Complaint Automation

### How it works
A customer sends a Telegram message with their order ID and complaint. The workflow looks up the order in Google Sheets, checks the customer's complaint history, classifies the message sentiment with GPT-4o-mini, and applies a rule engine to decide one of four routes: auto-approve a replacement (low-value wrong item, first offence), escalate to the support lead (high-value or angry customer), alert the warehouse team (damaged or missing item), or flag to the ops manager (repeat offender). Each route logs a record to the Complaints Log sheet and notifies the relevant person on Telegram. When a support lead approves or rejects via inline button, a second Telegram trigger fires, updates the sheet, and notifies both the customer and warehouse. After an auto-approval, the workflow waits 3 days and sends a feedback request.

### Setup steps
1. Connect **Telegram Bot API** to all Telegram nodes.
2. Connect **OpenAI API** to the sentiment classification node.
3. Connect **Google Sheets OAuth2** and create a sheet with two tabs: `Orders` and `Complaints Log` (see Credentials sticky for column names).
4. Replace `YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID` in every Google Sheets node.
5. Replace `YOUR_SUPPORT_LEAD_CHAT_ID`, `YOUR_WAREHOUSE_CHAT_ID`, and `YOUR_OPS_MANAGER_CHAT_ID` in the respective Telegram notify nodes.
6. Connect **Slack OAuth2** and replace `YOUR_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID` in the error alert node.
7. Activate both Telegram triggers.

## 📩 Complaint Intake & AI Analysis
Receives the customer's Telegram message (format: `ORDER_ID | complaint text`), looks up the order, checks complaint history for repeat behaviour, and uses GPT-4o-mini to classify sentiment. All data is merged before the routing decision.

## 🔀 Rule Engine
Combines issue type, order value, customer sentiment, and repeat-offender flag to decide one of four routes: auto-approve, escalate to support lead, alert warehouse, or flag to ops manager.

## ✅ Auto-Approve Branch
For low-value wrong-item complaints from first-time offenders. Instantly logs the resolution, sends the customer a replacement confirmation, then waits 3 days before sending a feedback check-in.

## 🔴 Support Lead Escalation
High-value orders or angry/frustrated customers go here. Sends the support lead an inline-button Telegram message and logs the complaint as `pending_human_approval`.

## 🏭 Warehouse Branch
Damaged or missing items are flagged to the warehouse team with the packer and courier names for CCTV/packing-log review. The workflow then checks if the same packer has 3+ complaints this week and alerts ops if so.

## 🔁 Repeat Offender Branch
Customers with 3+ complaints this month are blocked from auto-resolution. The ops manager receives a full context alert and the case is logged as `flagged_repeat_offender` for manual review.

## 👆 Support Lead Approval Callback
A separate Telegram trigger listens for the support lead's inline-button tap. Approve updates the sheet, notifies the customer and warehouse. Reject logs the decision and tells the support lead to follow up manually.

## ⚠️ Error Handling
A workflow-level error trigger posts an alert to Slack whenever any node fails. Update the channel ID to your ops or alerts channel before activating.

## 🔑 Credentials Required
- **Telegram Bot API** — all Telegram nodes
- **OpenAI API** — sentiment classification
- **Google Sheets OAuth2** — Orders + Complaints Log tabs
- **Slack OAuth2** — error alerts

`Orders`: order_id, customer_name, customer_phone, ordered_sku, packed_sku, packer_name, courier_name, order_value
`Complaints Log`: timestamp, order_id, customer_phone, customer_name, issue_type, route, liability, packer_name, courier_name, status
